stories.title: U.S. Agencies Warn of Hackers Targeting Industrial Refrigeration to Disrupt Food and Medicine Storage
stories.description: CISA and FBI warned of hackers targeting refrigeration systems, threatening food and medicine storage.

stories.title: U.S. Agencies Warn Refrigeration Controller Attacks Could Cause Fires and Inventory Losses
stories.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of European supermarkets, manipulating refrigeration controllers to spoil food and cause financial losses.

stories.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
stories.description: CISA adds SonicWall SonicOS flaw CVE-2026-19868 to its KEV catalog following reports of possible exploitation involving SAML authentication bypass.

stories.title: Hackers Begin Exploiting OpenSSH SSHole Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
stories.description: Attackers have started targeting the SSHole authentication bypass affecting certain OpenSSH servers, according to new SANS Internet Storm Center findings.

stories.title: Claude AI Accidentally Deletes Law Professor’s Entire Syllabus and One Year of Lecture Notes
stories.description: University of Chicago law professor William Baude says Anthropic’s Claude AI deleted his current syllabus and a year of constitutional law lecture notes while handling a simple editing task.

stories.title: NVIDIA Investigates Suspected Chinese Spy Operation Targeting CEO Jensen Huang
stories.description: NVIDIA has opened an independent investigation into reports that a foreign intelligence operation targeted founder and CEO Jensen Huang.

stories.title: SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins

stories.title: Claude Code's “Don't Ask Again” File Exposes Passwords and Keys in 1,122 Public Copies on GitHub

stories.title: Japan Announces Emergency Cybersecurity Package Following a Wave of Attacks
stories.description: The emergency package comes after dozens of companies and government agencies were hit by unauthorized access to their systems and leaks of client data, prompting uneasiness across Japan.

stories.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
stories.description: WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.
